filter_note.note: Sunday of Week 6 games, stamped Week 7 per weeks.json (Sun-Sat). Loudest rooms: BUF, CLE, PIT, CHI, NO, PHI, KC, DAL, CAR, GB. Dropped mostly college football (Auburn over Georgia, Tennessee over Alabama and the SEC fine, Miami-FSU and AP No. 1, BYU-Notre Dame, Texas Tech, Baylor-TCU, Houston-Oklahoma State), other sports (Hornets, Celtics/Paul George, Celtic FC, NYCFC, Minnesota United, Rangers/Hurricanes, F1, ARCA, Brewers), Taylor Swift and Kelce fashion, Tom Brady tuck-rule joke, Ryan Fitzpatrick-Talib self-roast, Mina Kimes media item, Ditka patch tribute, Hallmark Bears movie, Caleb-vs-Rodgers comparisons, Bo Nix memes, a garbled Jets-Eagles challenge story, last week's 49ers-Seahawks trash talk, non-football Detroit and NYC items, and many cross-club duplicates of the same game stories.

items.title: Cardinals stun Rams 18-16 on walk-off field goal
items.one_line: Chad Ryland hit a career-high six field goals, including a 43-yarder as time expired at SoFi.

items.title: Falcons fall 31-23 at Chicago
items.one_line: Caleb Williams returned and Kyler Gordon's late strip-sack on Michael Penix Jr. ended Atlanta's fourth-quarter rally.

items.title: Browns stun Ravens 13-10 on final-play field goal
items.one_line: Baltimore blew a 10-0 lead and fell to 4-2; Cleveland takes sole possession of first in the AFC North.

items.title: Lamar Jackson out again; Tyler Huntley starts
items.one_line: Jackson missed a second straight game with the sprained ankle, and Huntley opened with a touchdown drive.

items.title: Rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane back from wrist fracture
items.one_line: Activated after four games out and made an early first-down catch at Cleveland.

items.title: Allen's escape TD lifts Bills over Raiders 33-30
items.one_line: Josh Allen spun free for a touchdown to Keon Coleman in a close win in Las Vegas.

items.title: DJ Moore and Ed Oliver inactive again
items.one_line: Second straight missed game for both (shoulder, knee); Mike Danna, Ar'maj Reed-Adams, and Jude Bowry also sat.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid's rib injury
items.one_line: Left in the third quarter for X-rays, then came back in the fourth; analysts read it as a bruise, with the bye next.

items.title: Panthers top Eagles 25-14 in Philadelphia
items.one_line: Bryce Young threw two TDs to Tommy Tremble and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards.

items.title: Jaelan Phillips re-aggravates hamstring
items.one_line: The edge rusher exited in the first quarter against his old team; Thomas Incoom also limped off.

items.title: Caleb Williams returns in 31-23 win over Atlanta
items.one_line: 30-of-36 for 305 yards after three weeks out with a hamstring; Kyler Gordon had three sacks and two forced fumbles.

items.title: Bears fans defend Ben Johnson after Sun-Times column
items.one_line: A column blamed Johnson's preseason talk after the Green Bay loss; fans pushed back hard.

items.title: Browns stun Ravens 13-10, take AFC North lead
items.one_line: Andre Szmyt's 37-yarder at the gun; Cleveland is 4-2 and alone in first for the first time since 2014.

items.title: Judkins and Mason Graham inactive vs. Baltimore
items.one_line: Quinshon Judkins (ankle), Graham (ankle/knee), Mike Hall Jr., and Teven Jenkins all sat.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr. active at Lambeau despite ankle
items.one_line: The corner rolled his ankle in practice but suited up for Sunday night.

items.title: Jordan Love opens SNF with a record drive vs. Dallas
items.one_line: Love went 6-of-8 for 109 yards and a TD on a 90-yard opening march.

items.title: Playbook flip-flops tied to Bo Nix's slide
items.one_line: Payton took back play-calling and reverted the terminology Davis Webb had changed; Nix has 1,049 yards through six games.

items.title: Jonathon Cooper cleared from Commissioner Exempt List
items.one_line: The linebacker is eligible for Week 7 at Arizona while the league review stays open.

items.title: Jordan Love's record opening drive vs. Dallas
items.one_line: 6-of-8 for 109 yards and a touchdown on a 90-yard march to open Sunday night.

items.title: Josh Jacobs coming off the Commissioner Exempt List
items.one_line: Eligible to practice and play Week 7 at Detroit; the league's investigation stays open.

items.title: Rookie WR Savion Williams activated
items.one_line: Back from an ankle injury for the Cowboys game.

items.title: Texans edge Jaguars 34-31 in London
items.one_line: Ka'imi Fairbairn's 49-yarder at the gun; C.J. Stroud threw three TDs and Houston is 2-4.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. debuts for Houston
items.one_line: First Texans game after the midweek trade.

items.title: Colts blow 13-0 halftime lead, lose 26-20 to Titans
items.one_line: Indianapolis falls to 2-4 against a team that was winless.

items.title: Sauce Gardner exits with calf injury
items.one_line: Ruled questionable to return; he has a history of calf trouble.

items.title: Trade-deadline teardown talk
items.one_line: Evan Sidery listed Taylor, Nelson, Buckner, Gardner, Ward, and Stewart as possible trade candidates.

items.title: Jaguars lose 34-31 to Texans at Wembley
items.one_line: Travis Hunter caught a TD and picked a pass; Trevor Lawrence threw four TDs; Jacksonville falls to 4-2.

items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. trade buzz after zero-catch game
items.one_line: Zero catches on five targets over two games; reports say the team is open to a deal.

items.title: Full home slate planned for 2028
items.one_line: Team president Mark Lamping says the Jaguars will play every home game at the renovated EverBank Stadium in 2028.

items.title: Chiefs beat Chargers 22-6, stay unbeaten
items.one_line: Kenneth Walker III ran for 128 yards and two TDs; Kansas City is 5-0.

items.title: Watson and Armstrong elevated for depth
items.one_line: Practice-squad WR call-ups with receivers hurt.

items.title: Nikko Remigio's punt-return fumble draws fire
items.one_line: Fans want the returner cut despite the win.

items.title: Raiders fall 33-30 to Bills
items.one_line: Josh Allen's escape TD helped Buffalo win in Las Vegas with a crowd full of Bills fans.

items.title: Rookie Caleb Rogers starts over Powers-Johnson at RG
items.one_line: Jackson Powers-Johnson was benched in warmups; fans questioned keeping Burford at LG.

items.title: Ladd McConkey out with concussion at Arrowhead
items.one_line: Hit his head on the turf in the second quarter after just coming back from a foot injury.

items.title: Chargers lose 22-6 at Kansas City
items.one_line: Still winless; Kenneth Walker III ran for two TDs against them.

items.title: Rams lose 18-16 to Cardinals on final-play field goal
items.one_line: Los Angeles falls to 2-4 after briefly leading 16-15 late.

items.title: New kicker Blake Grupe hurts knee on debut kickoff
items.one_line: Signed this week after Harrison Mevis was released; hurt making a tackle, leaving the punter to kick.

items.title: Trent McDuffie ruled out (groin)
items.one_line: The star corner sat against Arizona after missing Friday's practice.

items.title: Patriots beat Jets 26-19, third straight win
items.one_line: Drake Maye threw three TDs; New England is 4-2 atop the AFC East with a short week at Chicago next.

items.title: A.J. Brown's rough return from IR
items.one_line: Three catches on 10 targets with at least three drops; he said his timing was off.

items.title: Injury pile-up before the Bears game
items.one_line: Will Campbell, Morgan Moses, Marcus Bryant, Carlton Davis III, and Karon Prunty were all on the report.

items.title: Saints beat Giants 34-27, snap three-game skid
items.one_line: 34 straight points behind Tyler Shough and Alvin Kamara.

items.title: Shough playing through two broken bones in his hand
items.one_line: Hurt in Week 4 against Atlanta; he's started every game since in a glove.

items.title: Paris game vs. Steelers stays on amid protests
items.one_line: The NFL and Saints say preparations are on track for next Sunday at Stade de France.

items.title: Giants lose 34-27 to Saints
items.one_line: New York's backs ran for 34 yards and Cam Skattebo got zero carries; J.J. McCarthy's late surge fell short.

items.title: Fans pan the McCarthy package
items.one_line: A designed J.J. McCarthy run lost two yards and the fan base let it fly.

items.title: Jets fall 26-19 at New England
items.one_line: Drake Maye threw three TDs; the Jets' comeback ended on a recovered onside kick.

items.title: Eagles lose 25-14 to Panthers, fourth straight loss
items.one_line: Tanner McKee started for Hurts; Philadelphia had 222 total yards and fell to 2-4.

items.title: Injury list grows: Nolan Smith concussion
items.one_line: Hurts (IR) and Saquon Barkley (hamstring) were already out; Carson Steele and Jordan Davis also got hurt.

items.title: McKee's numbers mirror Hurts'
items.one_line: 26-of-45 for 215 yards in his first start, close to Hurts' averages, shifting the blame talk.

items.title: Steelers rally from 13 down, beat Bucs 26-19 in OT
items.one_line: Rodgers hit rookie Germie Bernard for the winner; Jalen Ramsey had two sacks; Pittsburgh is 4-2.

items.title: Paris game vs. Saints stays on amid protests
items.one_line: The league says next Sunday at Stade de France is on track despite unrest in France.

items.title: Pat Freiermuth played through calf tightness
items.one_line: Questionable Saturday, then cleared for Tampa.

items.title: Mustapha fined for uncalled hit on Smith-Njigba
items.one_line: The league fined the 49ers safety $6,998 for the Week 5 hit on Seattle's final drive.

items.title: Bosa and Deebo out for Monday night vs. Washington
items.one_line: Nick Bosa (calf), Deebo Samuel (hamstring), Marques Sigle, and Garret Wallow sit; Mike Evans questionable.

items.title: Malik Mustapha fined $6,998
items.one_line: For the uncalled hit on Jaxon Smith-Njigba in the win at Seattle; he answered 'Soft.'

items.title: Trent Williams on his Washington years
items.one_line: Williams said he sometimes forgets his time there ahead of facing his old team.

items.title: Bucs blow 13-point fourth-quarter lead, lose 26-19 in OT
items.one_line: Pittsburgh scored 16 straight and Jalen Ramsey's sack ended it.

items.title: Titans get first win, rally past Colts 26-20
items.one_line: Down 13-0 at half, the defense and special teams flipped it for Robert Saleh's first win.

items.title: Alontae Taylor a healthy scratch amid trade talk
items.one_line: The $60 million corner sat for Joshua Williams; reports note trade interest.

items.title: Croskey-Merritt and Mariota out for Monday night at SF
items.one_line: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin), Marcus Mariota (knee), Jean-Baptiste, and Omenihu all sit.
